speaker: BRY
text: Bro-bro-bro, I was in Miami!  Like, yesterday, bro!

speaker: NARR
text: What the fuck is wrong with this dude?

speaker: NARR
text: This is Bryce.  He has never told the truth.  Yesterday he was in my math class.

speaker: BRY
text: Then I dunked on a pro. Twice.

speaker: NARR
text: He jumps for the rim.  The ball hits him right in the face.

speaker: NARR
text: Second period. Music.  Bryce says he toured with a band.

speaker: BRY
text: Drums, bass, piano. I did everything.

speaker: NARR
text: The teacher hands him a recorder.

speaker: BRY
text: Fweee! Fweee! FWEEEE!

speaker: NARR
text: That's not a note.  That's a smoke alarm.

speaker: NARR
text: Lunch at the school store.  I unwrap my sandwich.

speaker: BRY
text: Bro, put that away.  I'm allergic to bread.

speaker: NARR
text: Allergic. To bread.  He ate a burger yesterday.

speaker: NARR
text: I turn around to pay.  I turn back.

speaker: BRY
text: Relax. This is a salad.

speaker: NARR
text: It was my sandwich.

speaker: NARR
text: After school. Science fair.  I built a lie detector.

speaker: NARR
text: Bryce, were you in Miami?

speaker: BRY
text: Yes. Obviously, bro.

speaker: NARR
text: Green light. Nothing.

speaker: HARG
text: Tyler, did you build this yourself?

speaker: NARR
text: I said yes. It went off.

speaker: HARG
text: Disqualified. Lying to a judge.

speaker: NARR
text: Bryce won first place.  I got detention.  And my sandwich is still a salad.
